mainEntity.name: What is the difference between Shared Hosting and VPS Hosting in Pakistan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Shared hosting shares server resources among multiple websites and is cost-effective (starting Rs. 1,499/year) for small websites and blogs. VPS hosting provides dedicated CPU, RAM, and root access for high-traffic stores and enterprise applications.

acceptedAnswer.text: Buying hosting in PKR protects Pakistani business owners from USD dollar exchange rate spikes, international bank transaction taxes (3-5%), and credit card blockages by local banks.

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes! Every shared, WordPress, and reseller hosting plan at Zedgehost includes official cPanel control panel, 1-click WordPress installer, free Let's Encrypt AutoSSL, and 24/7 local support.
